name: Switch
access: OML creates this object from a selector:Switch node. Reach the instance with find or cfind, then call methods on that instance. Method names are not OML keys.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Two items of {label, value}. Defaults to [{label: 'OFF', value: 0}, {label: 'ON', value: 1}]. Optional.

properties.name: labels
properties.description: Show labels. Defaults to true. Optional.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current value. A data-value attribute on the element is read with OGX.Data.stringToVal and then removed. Optional.

properties.name: speed
properties.description: Animation speed in milliseconds. Defaults to 250. Optional.

methods.name: val
methods.description: Gets the value, or sets it. The second argument triggers CHANGE when true.

events.name: OGX.Switch.CHANGE
events.description: The value changed. The event string is SwitchChange. OGX.Switch.BIND is the same constant.

catalog_status: Listed fields and methods are from the OGX.JS wiki or the runtime the test app loads. Members that are absent from this file are not to be invented.
